summary: Well-specified task: owner expressed the end-state (treat check-status lookup errors as a distinct 'unknown' state, take no action on it, preserve never-auto-merge-on-unverified) and explicitly delegated the confirmation-before-rework sub-policy to the work; acceptance criteria set, including a code-derived auto-merge safety fix.

acceptance_criteria: The checks_state contract (PRStatusSchema in src/schemas/adapters.ts) gains a distinct 'unknown' value alongside passing|failing|pending|none, and the ChecksState local type in github-hosting.ts is updated to match.

When the check-status lookup errors (network blip / ECONNRESET / dropped connection / rate-limit / any failure of the status or checks API call), getPRStatus returns checks_state 'unknown', never 'failing'.
On checks_state 'unknown', no pr_ci_failure event is derived (derivePrEvents emits nothing for it), so the task is not re-entered into rework.

On checks_state 'unknown', the PR is never auto-merged and never promoted to ready-to-merge: auto-merge readiness treats 'unknown' as wait-and-retry (not merge), and the /approve promotion path does not promote on 'unknown' — preserving 'never auto-merge on unverified status'.

On checks_state 'unknown', the task simply stays waiting (blocked pr_review_pending) and is re-checked next poll — no rework notice, no approval dismissal, no re-push, no phantom pr_ci_failure notification.
Genuine failing and passing behavior is preserved: a real red check still routes to rework (subject to the resolved confirmation policy); a real green + approved + mergeable PR still merges.

Every existing consumer of checks_state is audited and handles 'unknown' safely — no consumer treats it as passing (merge) or failing (rework); specifically the auto-merge.ts decideReadiness fall-through is fixed to route 'unknown' to retry_wait.

The owner-delegated confirmation policy is resolved and documented during design (whether a genuine failing reading is confirmed by a re-check/small retry before driving rework); whichever policy is chosen, a single transient/flaky reading never triggers a rework cycle, and the decision is recorded.

Docs describing checks_state are updated to include 'unknown' (docs/plugins/git-hosting/README.md and github-hosting.md) and the generated bundle src/cli/bundled/plugin-docs.ts is regenerated via pnpm run docs:bundle (CI fails on drift).

A regression test proves the fix: a transient check-status lookup error yields checks_state 'unknown' and produces no pr_ci_failure event and no merge, exercising the real error path; related check-state, derivePrEvents, auto-merge, and poller tests are updated as needed.
Project gates pass: pnpm run typecheck, pnpm run lint, pnpm test (unit), and pnpm run test:integration.
